prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean spray (sunless) tanning or UV tanning beds/booths? The best salon depends on which service you want.

If you tell me which type you want (and any other preferences like price, privacy, or mobile service), I can give more specific recommendations. In the meantime, here are quick tips to identify the best local salon:

- For spray/sunless tanning: look for salons that advertise trained technicians and reputable solutions (brands like Versa, Norvell, or Mystic), offer a patch test, show before/after photos, have consistently high recent reviews, and explain prep/aftercare.
- For UV tanning: choose places with modern, well-maintained beds/stand-up booths, clear safety rules, eye protection, trained staff, and up-to-date licensing and hygiene. Note health risks of UV tanning and follow safe-exposure guidance.
- How to find top picks: check Google Maps and Yelp for 4+ star businesses with many recent reviews, read several recent reviews (last 6–12 months), look at customer photos, and call to ask about equipment, technician experience, products, and pricing.
- Ask about refunds/re-touches for spray tans, and whether they require appointments or accept walk-ins.

If you want, tell me “spray” or “UV” (and your zip code or part of Pleasanton) and I’ll list nearby salons that match your preferences and what to ask them.
